quests.title: Short Delivery, Waitara
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. The Waitara order has been two cartons light every week since Thursdays and the invoice says otherwise every time. It started small, the way these things do. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: the loading bay round the side
the pallet as it actually arrives
now I have got something to send them

quests.title: The Credit Note, Waitara
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. They admitted it, which I did not expect, so now there is $70 owing to Waitara and it is not going to walk in here itself. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: $70, and do not take a voucher
cash, on the counter, and I will believe it

quests.title: The Waitara Run
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. I do the Waitara run at first light and there is a stretch of it where the van gets followed, which I have told nobody until now. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. That's the whole job. No catch.

steps.label: ride it with me as far as Hornsby
whatever is behind us when we stop

quests.title: Locked Out, Waitara
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. I have got a roll of raffle tickets in the back of the van and the Waitara shop is shut, and the number on the door rings out. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Be polite about it. It costs nothing.

steps.label: try the flat above the shop
get one in you, this takes a while
somebody has to sign for it

quests.title: The Regulars, Waitara
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. Three of the Waitara regulars have started coming in together and going out separately, and the till is $87 down on those days. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: the ones who come in as a set
$87, which is exactly what the till says

quests.title: The Wholesaler, Waitara
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. Everything Waitara sells comes off a floor at Hornsby, and the woman who runs it will tell you things she will not put in writing. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: go and see her before the afternoon
come and tell me what she said about us

quests.title: Under 12s at Macdonaldtown
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. I have got eleven kids for a twelve-a-side at Macdonaldtown on the first of the month and one of them has a note from his mother. It started small, the way these things do. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: the estate behind the ground, ask around
the noticeboard where the sign-on sheet went up
any kid with boots will do at this point

quests.title: Registration, Macdonaldtown
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. We found a twelfth, which means the Macdonaldtown club now owes the association $78 it had budgeted on not owing. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: $78 before the cut-off
I will drive it in myself

quests.title: The Macdonaldtown Canteen
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. The canteen at Macdonaldtown does two hundred sausages on a Saturday and this week the freezer went off at the middle of the news. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. That's the whole job. No catch.

steps.label: we are going to need the coffee
the thermometer, so the insurance believes us

quests.title: Grand Final Float, Macdonaldtown
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. Somebody walked off with the float from the Macdonaldtown canteen at about the middle of the news during the last home game, and I have a fair idea which somebody. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Be polite about it. It costs nothing.

steps.label: the pair who were leaning on the roller door
$62, which is what was in the tin

quests.title: Sprinkler Line, Macdonaldtown
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. The sprinkler line under the Macdonaldtown outfield has been leaking since the first of the month and the wet patch has started to move. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: walk the line from the tap to the boundary
where the grass has gone dark
I want to dig once, not five times

quests.title: The Association, Macdonaldtown
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. The bloke who allocates grounds for the whole association sits at St Peters, and Macdonaldtown has been at the bottom of his list for two seasons. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: go and be reasonable at him
tell me if it is us or the paperwork

quests.title: The Creek Behind Minto
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. Somebody has been tipping fill into the creek behind Minto since grand final week and it is narrowing the channel a metre at a time. It started small, the way these things do. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: the fill, with the water level in shot
the council reads photographs, not letters

quests.title: Willow Removal, Minto
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. They have agreed to a clean-up at Minto, which is wonderful, except the grant is $81 short and closes on grand final week. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: $81, and I do not care whose pocket
the form needs the number today

quests.title: Sandbags, Minto
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. We had 93 sandbags in the Minto shed on grand final week and this morning we have got the pallet they came on. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. That's the whole job. No catch.

steps.label: the yards backing onto the reserve
anywhere they have obviously been used

quests.title: The Low Crossing, Minto
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. People keep driving the low crossing at Minto at the middle of the news with the water over the sign, and one of them is going to be the one. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Be polite about it. It costs nothing.

steps.label: you will be standing out there a while
the ones who argue with the barrier

quests.title: Under the House, Minto
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. The water came through my place at Minto on grand final week and the assessor wants photographs of things I have already thrown out. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: round the side, where the pile is
the high-water mark on the brick
that is the whole claim, that mark

quests.title: Upstream, Minto
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. Whatever is happening to Minto starts upstream at Leumeah, and there are people up there who have been saying so for years. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: go up and find them
I want to hear it from someone who is not me
